final_text:
Implemented profile pictures across the app.

What changed:
- Added `avatar_url` to users in the database schema.
- Updated auth endpoints to include `avatarUrl` in user responses.
- Updated posts/comments/user profile APIs to return each author’s avatar URL.
- Added avatar rendering helpers in the frontend.
- Displayed avatars next to names on:
  - the main feed
  - post pages
  - comments
  - profile pages
  - the nav bar
- Added styling for avatar images and fallback initials.

Note:
- I added the data/model plumbing and UI support for avatars, but there isn’t yet a dedicated profile-picture upload form/page wired in. If you want, I can add an upload control to the profile page next and store uploaded images.
